# Exemptions for scripts/scan-known-identities.sh, one per line.
#
# `path` exempts a whole tracked file. Keep these to generated files that cannot hold fixtures or prose.
#
# `path<TAB>text` exempts only that exact, case-sensitive text inside that one file; every other
# identity in the file, and the same text anywhere else, is still reported. Use it for public
# identifiers that must stay, such as a repository URL or organisation slug, never for a person's name.
#
# Cargo.lock lists dependency crate names only; a roster entry that is also a crate name (bare `syn`)
# would otherwise produce hits no source change can clear.
Cargo.lock
